businesses.business: flow measurement and water quality instruments

offering_description.value: Manufactures flow measurement, control and water quality instruments and smart water metering systems. Sells to water and gas utilities and industrial customers. Products are made in-house and include meters, radios, software and sensors.

primary_products.value: water meters (mechanical, ultrasonic, and cellular-connected); flow meters and sensors; automatic meter reading radios and endpoints; water quality sensors; control valves

primary_services.value: cloud-hosted meter data management software; cellular network connectivity for metering data

customer_segment.value: B2B: investor-owned water utilities, industrial and OEM customers, process industries, HVAC and building systems; B2G: municipal water utilities and public water districts

end_markets.value: water utilities; industrial process; oil and gas; HVAC and building systems; aerospace and automotive fluids

revenue_model.value: product sales: meters, flow instruments, sensors and radios; subscription: software-as-a-service and cellular connectivity for metering data

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds meters and instruments from castings, electronics and components, sold to utilities, distributors and industrial customers; software / platform: cloud data analytics platform for utilities

geography_served.value: global: US primarily, plus Europe, Mexico, Middle East and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: water meters, flow instrumentation, sensors, communications and software

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: waterworks distributors and independent sales representatives selling to utilities; direct sales: industrial, OEM and large utility accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: drinking-water product standards such as NSF/ANSI 61 and AWWA, lead-free requirements, and metrology accuracy rules
